digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and help system
propositions: Command syntax is split across reusable argparse parsers, imperative argv loops, 54 hand-maintained help files, and 22 curated intercept descriptions, causing documentation and runtime to diverge.
A single parser/route registry foundation with side-effect-free argparse factories must be established before runtime help and documentation cutover.

All core (ticket/store/config/maintenance) and advanced (bridge/reconciler/LLM/workflow/audit/identity) command families must be migrated from imperative parsing to pure factories with atomic handler switching and argv parity validation.
Generated package-help and grouped-overview bytes must become canonical and byte-deterministic, replacing all docs-only grammar and source-regex command definitions.
Parser migrations must capture production-path test oracles (positive, negative, boundary, exit codes, diagnostics) before atomically switching runtime and factory.
Compatibility shims and hidden/retired commands must be explicitly declared; rollback must revert parser families and artifacts together without stored data changes.
